head: 47234a1924737f83d2496814c473660c453bfe23
claim: Apps can export a Pi, Claude, Codex or opencode conversation from one managed folder, import it into another and get identical files, through the packed @byokit/herdr 0.17.1

steps.start: Conversations exist in managed account A for pi, claude, codex and opencode
steps: Pack @byokit/herdr 0.17.1 and install the tarball in an external consumer
Export each conversation from account A with kit.exportConversation
Import it into isolated account B with importConversation
Compare restored files byte for byte
steps.result: Export and import succeeded for pi, claude, codex and opencode; restored files are identical.

verdicts.seen: I read all four entries (pi, claude, codex, opencode) plus the PASS line. Each shows 'export ok' and 'import ok', and each reports 'bytes identical in account B: true'. The capture was installed @byokit/herdr 0.17.1, matching the version in the outcome. The outcome names one check across four agents, not separate widths or frames, so no parts are listed.
